name: chat-interface-testimonial
title: Chat Interface Testimonial
blurb: Staggered items that animate in blur-fade sequence on scroll into view.
description: Scroll-triggered animation wrapper for timeline or process steps. Elements blur-fade and shift vertically in staggered sequence based on animationNum. Supports custom variants and polymorphic rendering via the `as` prop.
use_when: Animating timeline steps, process flows, or chat message sequences where sequential reveal adds visual storytelling.
avoid_when: When viewing testimonials on slow connections — blur effect + stagger creates multiple animation frames per item.
a11y: Motion-triggered on scroll; no prefers-reduced-motion guard. Content is accessible but animations run regardless of user preference.
